senses.en: A small folding case for carrying money and cards.

ex.en: I left my wallet beside the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 我把钱包落在厨房水槽旁了。

ex.en: As digital payments become more common, fewer consumers need to carry cash in a wallet.
ex.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，需要在钱包里携带现金的消费者越来越少。

tip: wallet通常指放纸币和卡片的折叠式钱包。

senses.en: To bring separate parts or groups together as one.

ex.en: The neighbourhood festival helped unify our divided community.
ex.zh: 邻里节庆帮助我们这个存在隔阂的社区团结起来。

ex.en: A shared public transport network could unify the region while improving access to employment.
ex.zh: 共享的公共交通网络既能将该地区连成一体，也能让人们更方便地获得就业机会。

col: unify different groups｜使不同群体团结
tip: unify强调把分散部分合成整体，可用于制度或群体。

senses.en: Extremely useful or valuable.

ex.en: Your advice was invaluable when I bought my first bicycle.
ex.zh: 我买第一辆自行车时，你的建议帮了大忙。

ex.en: Practical work experience provides students with invaluable insights into the skills employers expect from new graduates.
ex.zh: 实际工作经验能帮助学生深入了解雇主对新毕业生技能的期望，这种了解十分宝贵。

col: an invaluable resource｜极有用的资源
tip: invaluable意为极宝贵，不是没有价值。

senses.en: relating to the Eastern Orthodox Christian churches
following traditional Jewish religious laws and practices

ex.en: We visited an Orthodox church with beautiful painted icons.
ex.zh: 我们参观了一座装饰着精美圣像画的东正教教堂。

ex.en: Preserving Orthodox churches can protect architectural heritage while helping visitors understand the religious traditions of local communities.
ex.zh: 保护东正教教堂既能保存建筑遗产，也能帮助游客了解当地社区的宗教传统。

tip: 大写常指宗教派别；小写orthodox可指正统的、传统的。

senses.en: an experienced male political leader respected for wisdom and judgement

ex.en: The retired statesman spoke calmly to the gathered crowd.
ex.zh: 这位退休的资深政治家平静地向聚集的人群讲话。

ex.en: A respected statesman can help resolve international disputes by encouraging dialogue and building trust between governments.
ex.zh: 一位受尊敬的资深政治家可以通过鼓励对话、建立政府间信任，帮助解决国际争端。

tip: 通常含褒义，不宜译作贬义的“政客”；女性用 stateswoman。

senses.en: A covered area immediately outside a building's entrance.

ex.en: We left our muddy boots on the porch overnight.
ex.zh: 我们把沾满泥的靴子放在门廊上过了一夜。

ex.en: A shaded porch can reduce indoor temperatures while providing residents with a comfortable outdoor meeting space.
ex.zh: 带遮阴的门廊既能降低室内温度，也能为住户提供舒适的户外交流空间。

col: sit on the porch｜坐在门廊上
tip: 指入口外的有顶空间，不是室内走廊。

senses.en: a large military unit or branch with particular duties
an organized group of people doing the same specialized work

ex.en: My cousin joined the medical corps after finishing university.
ex.zh: 我表亲大学毕业后加入了军队医疗部队。

ex.en: The diplomatic corps can support international cooperation by maintaining communication between governments during periods of tension.
ex.zh: 外交使团可以在紧张时期维持政府之间的沟通，从而支持国际合作。

tip: 单复数拼写相同；单数不读ps，复数词尾读/z/。

senses.en: To travel regularly between home and work.
A regular journey between home and work.
To replace a legal punishment with a less severe one.

ex.en: I commute by train and usually read a book.
ex.zh: 我坐火车上下班，路上通常会看书。

ex.en: Employees who commute long distances may experience greater stress and have less time for family activities.
ex.zh: 长距离通勤的员工可能承受更大压力，陪伴家人的时间也更少。

tip: 通勤用 commute to work；减刑用 commute a sentence。

senses.zh: 大声疾呼， 呐喊； 强烈抗议
蒸馏， 用蒸馏法提取； 吸取， 提炼

senses.en: loss of the ability to move part or all of the body
a state in which action or progress becomes impossible

ex.en: The injury caused temporary paralysis in his left leg.
ex.zh: 这次受伤导致他的左腿暂时瘫痪。

ex.en: Political disagreements can lead to administrative paralysis, delaying essential decisions on housing and public transport.
ex.zh: 政治分歧可能导致行政停滞，延误有关住房和公共交通的重要决策。

tip: 既指身体瘫痪，也可比喻机构或决策陷入停滞。

senses.en: an official count of people that collects information about them

ex.en: We completed the census form at our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房餐桌旁填好了人口普查表。

ex.en: Census data help governments plan housing, schools and healthcare services according to changing population needs.
ex.zh: 人口普查数据帮助政府根据不断变化的人口需求规划住房、学校和医疗服务。

col: conduct a census｜开展人口普查
a national census｜全国人口普查
tip: census调查全部人口，sample survey只抽样。

senses.en: to show or describe something in art, images, or words

ex.en: This painting depicts children playing beside a quiet lake.
ex.zh: 这幅画描绘了孩子们在宁静的湖边玩耍的情景。

ex.en: Films often depict urban life as exciting, overlooking the isolation that many residents experience in large cities.
ex.zh: 电影常将城市生活描绘得令人兴奋，却忽略了许多大城市居民感受到的孤独。

col: depict daily life｜描绘日常生活
depict someone as｜将某人描绘成
tip: depict A as B：把A描绘成B。

senses.en: An icy object orbiting the sun, sometimes showing a bright tail

ex.en: We watched a bright comet through my uncle's telescope.
ex.zh: 我们用叔叔的望远镜观看了一颗明亮的彗星。

ex.en: Studying a comet can provide valuable evidence about the conditions in which our solar system formed.
ex.zh: 研究彗星可以提供有关太阳系形成时环境的重要证据。

tip: comet是彗星；meteor是进入大气后发光的流星。

senses.en: relating to European history from about AD 500 to 1500

ex.en: We explored a medieval castle during our weekend trip.
ex.zh: 我们在周末旅行中游览了一座中世纪城堡。

ex.en: Preserving medieval buildings allows modern communities to understand how earlier generations lived, worked, and organised their societies.
ex.zh: 保护中世纪建筑能让现代社区了解前人如何生活、工作及组织社会。

tip: 通常指欧洲约公元500至1500年的中世纪。

senses.en: A small gun designed to be held in one hand.

ex.en: The old pistol was displayed behind thick museum glass.
ex.zh: 那把旧手枪陈列在博物馆的厚玻璃后面。

ex.en: Strict pistol storage requirements can reduce accidental injuries and improve safety in local communities.
ex.zh: 严格的手枪存放要求可以减少意外伤害，提高当地社区的安全水平。

tip: pistol指手枪；rifle通常指步枪。

senses.zh: 富有想象力的；有创意的
senses.en: able to produce original ideas, or showing this ability

ex.en: My imaginative niece turned empty boxes into a spaceship.
ex.zh: 我那富有想象力的侄女把空盒子变成了一艘宇宙飞船。

ex.en: Schools should encourage imaginative thinking rather than require students to memorise every detail of a textbook.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励有创意的思考，而不是要求学生记住课本中的每一个细节。

col: imaginative solution｜有创意的解决方案
tip: imaginative指有想象力；imaginary指想象中的。

senses.en: a flightless seabird with black and white feathers, found mainly south

ex.en: The penguin waddled across the rocks towards the sea.
ex.zh: 那只企鹅摇摇摆摆地走过岩石，朝大海走去。

ex.en: Changes in ocean temperatures can affect penguin populations by altering the availability of fish and other prey.
ex.zh: 海水温度的变化会改变鱼类及其他猎物的供应量，从而影响企鹅种群。

tip: 企鹅是不会飞的鸟；并非全都生活在南极。

senses.zh: 人与人之间的， 关于人与人之间关系的
可作楷模的， 典范的
解雇； 裁员； 歇工期， 停工期
破裂， 分裂； 瓦解
盔甲， 装甲； 保护物

senses.en: An official who represents their country in relations with other countries.
Someone skilled at handling people and difficult situations tactfully.

ex.en: The diplomat welcomed visitors at the embassy this morning.
ex.zh: 这位外交官今天上午在大使馆接待了来访者。

ex.en: Experienced diplomats can help countries resolve disagreements through negotiation rather than allowing tensions to escalate.
ex.zh: 经验丰富的外交官能帮助各国通过谈判解决分歧，避免紧张局势升级。

tip: diplomatic既可指外交的，也可指说话圆通的。

senses.en: to shine with small, bright flashes of light
bright flashes of light, or a lively, exciting quality

ex.en: The tiny crystals sparkle whenever sunlight enters the room.
ex.zh: 每当阳光照进房间，那些小水晶就闪闪发亮。

ex.en: Although the river sparkles in the sunlight, regular testing is necessary to assess its water quality.
ex.zh: 尽管河水在阳光下波光粼粼，仍需定期检测以评估水质。

col: sparkle in the sunlight｜在阳光下闪耀
tip: sparkle强调点点闪光；shine泛指发光。

senses.zh: 主要的； 经常需要的
订书钉，U形钉；主食；主要产品

senses.en: Competition between people or groups seeking the same success.

ex.en: There is friendly rivalry between our two football teams.
ex.zh: 我们两支足球队之间存在友好的竞争。

ex.en: Commercial rivalry can encourage innovation, although excessive competition may discourage companies from sharing valuable research findings.
ex.zh: 商业竞争可以促进创新，但过度竞争可能使企业不愿分享有价值的研究成果。

col: sibling rivalry｜兄弟姐妹间的竞争
rivalry between teams｜队伍之间的竞争
tip: 强调持续的竞争关系，双方之间常用between。

senses.en: To enjoy something greatly or eagerly anticipate doing it.
Great enjoyment or enthusiasm when doing something.
A sauce of chopped vegetables or fruit eaten with food.

ex.en: I relish quiet mornings with tea and a book.
ex.zh: 我很享受喝着茶、读着书的宁静早晨。

ex.en: Many students relish the opportunity to study abroad because it exposes them to different cultures and perspectives.
ex.zh: 许多学生非常珍惜出国学习的机会，因为这能让他们接触不同的文化和观点。

col: relish a challenge｜乐于接受挑战
relish the opportunity｜欣然把握机会
tip: 动词后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: Emitting light through fluorescence, or using this effect for lighting.
Having an extremely bright, noticeable colour.

ex.en: The fluorescent lamp flickered above the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 厨房水槽上方的荧光灯闪烁不定。

ex.en: Replacing fluorescent lighting with more efficient alternatives can lower electricity consumption in schools and offices.
ex.zh: 用效率更高的照明设备替换荧光灯，可以降低学校和办公室的用电量。

tip: 注意拼写是fluorescent，常搭配lamp或tube。

senses.en: Allowed by law or accepted rules.
Fair, reasonable, and supported by good reasons.

ex.en: Selling homemade bread is a legitimate business here.
ex.zh: 在这里，售卖自制面包是合法的生意。

ex.en: Residents have legitimate concerns about the impact of airport expansion on local air quality.
ex.zh: 居民对机场扩建影响当地空气质量的担忧是合理的。

tip: 既可指法律允许，也可指理由或担忧合理。

senses.zh: 平息， 抚慰； 姑息

senses.en: a list of sources used or relevant to a subject

ex.en: I added the missing book to my essay's bibliography.
ex.zh: 我把漏掉的那本书补进了论文的参考书目。

ex.en: A carefully prepared bibliography allows readers to locate sources and examine the evidence supporting an academic argument.
ex.zh: 精心编制的参考书目能让读者找到资料来源，并查验支持学术论点的证据。

col: compile a bibliography｜编制参考书目
annotated bibliography｜附注释的参考书目
tip: bibliography是资料清单；biography是人物传记。

senses.en: to happen again, especially repeatedly or after an interval

ex.en: If these headaches recur, please speak to your doctor.
ex.zh: 如果这些头痛再次出现，请咨询医生。

ex.en: Traffic congestion will continue to recur unless cities address the underlying causes of excessive car use.
ex.zh: 除非城市解决汽车使用过度的根本原因，否则交通拥堵将继续反复出现。

col: a recurring problem｜反复出现的问题
a recurring theme｜反复出现的主题
tip: 不及物动词；过去式recurred，分词recurring。

senses.zh: 结合体， 同盟； 结合， 联合
断言， 宣称， 硬说

senses.en: To keep people apart based on race or other characteristics.
To separate things into different groups or locations.

ex.en: The club refused to segregate children by family income.
ex.zh: 这家俱乐部拒绝按家庭收入将孩子分开。

ex.en: Schools that segregate pupils by social background may reinforce inequality rather than promote mutual understanding.
ex.zh: 按社会背景隔离学生的学校可能会加剧不平等，而非促进相互理解。

col: racially segregated schools｜实行种族隔离的学校
tip: segregate A from B指把A与B隔离。

senses.zh: 拒绝， 不给； 抑制， 制止

senses.en: Careful not to reveal secrets or cause embarrassment.
Designed or chosen to avoid attracting attention.

ex.en: Please be discreet about the surprise party we're planning.
ex.zh: 请不要泄露我们正在筹备惊喜派对的事。

ex.en: Healthcare professionals must be discreet when discussing patients to protect their privacy and maintain public trust.
ex.zh: 医护人员讨论患者情况时必须谨慎，以保护患者隐私并维护公众信任。

col: a discreet entrance｜不显眼的入口
tip: 勿混discrete（分离的）；discreet强调谨慎低调。

senses.zh: 奖金， 红利； 额外给予的东西
座位间过道；货架间通道
senses.en: a passage between rows of seats or shelves

ex.en: Please keep your bag out of the aisle.
ex.zh: 请不要把包放在过道上。

ex.en: Wider supermarket aisles can improve accessibility for wheelchair users and make shopping more comfortable for everyone.
ex.zh: 更宽的超市通道能方便轮椅使用者通行，也能让所有人购物时更加舒适。

col: walk down the aisle｜沿过道走；结婚
tip: s不发音，与isle同音；aisle seat是靠过道座位。

senses.zh: 最可靠的， 权威性的； 决定性的
条纹，条痕；个性特征；一阵子，一连串

senses.en: the movement of people or goods between places
a system of buses, trains, or other shared transport

ex.en: The glasses broke while they were in transit.
ex.zh: 这些玻璃杯在运输途中破碎了。

ex.en: Investment in public transit can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善发展中城市居民的就业可达性。

tip: in transit指运输途中；public transit多用于美式英语。

senses.en: a young person developing from a child into an adult
relating to the stage between childhood and adulthood

ex.en: The club offers cooking classes for adolescents after school.
ex.zh: 这个俱乐部为青少年开设课后烹饪班。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can improve adolescent mental health and support the development of lasting social connections.
ex.zh: 定期运动可以改善青少年的心理健康，并帮助他们建立持久的社会联系。

col: adolescent mental health｜青少年心理健康
tip: 既可作名词也可作形容词；比 teenager 更正式。

senses.zh: 尽管如此， 依然， 然而

senses.en: A powerful, addictive stimulant drug derived from coca leaves.

ex.en: The nurse explained why cocaine can seriously harm the heart.
ex.zh: 护士解释了可卡因为何会严重损害心脏。

ex.en: Public health programmes should combine education about cocaine with accessible treatment for people experiencing addiction.
ex.zh: 公共卫生项目应将可卡因危害教育与便捷可及的成瘾治疗相结合。

tip: 通常为不可数名词，指一种强效成瘾性毒品。

senses.en: An object with strings used to hit balls in sports.
A loud, unpleasant noise.

ex.en: I left my tennis racket beside the court.
ex.zh: 我把网球拍落在球场边了。

ex.en: Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.
ex.zh: 提供球拍等基本器材，可以让更多孩子参与学校体育活动。

tip: 球拍也可拼作racquet；喧闹声只用racket。

senses.en: A good reason explaining why something is acceptable or necessary.

ex.en: There is no justification for leaving this mess behind.
ex.zh: 把这里弄得一团糟却不收拾，没有任何正当理由。

ex.en: Governments must provide clear justification for policies that restrict individual freedom in the interests of public safety.
ex.zh: 政府必须为那些以公共安全为由限制个人自由的政策提供明确的合理依据。

col: little justification｜几乎没有正当理由
economic justification｜经济上的合理依据
tip: 常接for加名词或动名词，说明某事的合理依据。

senses.en: Protected against a particular disease.
Relating to the body's defence against disease.
Not affected by something, or protected from a legal obligation.

ex.en: The vet explained that vaccination would make our puppy immune.
ex.zh: 兽医解释说，接种疫苗会让我们的小狗获得免疫力。

ex.en: Although technology creates new opportunities, no industry is completely immune to the effects of economic change.
ex.zh: 尽管技术创造了新机遇，但没有哪个行业能完全不受经济变化的影响。

col: immune to infection｜对感染有免疫力的
immune from prosecution｜免于被起诉的
tip: immune to指不受影响；immune from常指获豁免。

senses.en: A small booklet giving information about products, services, or places.

ex.en: I picked up a travel brochure at the station.
ex.zh: 我在车站拿了一本旅游宣传册。

ex.en: University brochures can help prospective students compare courses, accommodation options, and the facilities available on campus.
ex.zh: 大学宣传册可以帮助有意申请的学生比较课程、住宿选择及校园设施。

tip: 可数名词，常指介绍旅游、课程或产品的小册子。

senses.en: To replace a film's original speech with another language.
To give someone or something a particular name or description.

ex.en: They dubbed the cartoon into Spanish for younger viewers.
ex.zh: 他们为这部动画片配上西班牙语，方便年幼观众观看。

ex.en: Journalists have dubbed the new railway a lifeline for rural communities previously isolated from major employment centres.
ex.zh: 记者将这条新铁路称为乡村社区的生命线，这些社区此前与主要就业中心相隔绝。

tip: 过去式dubbed；dub A B表示“称A为B”。

senses.en: Genuine or traditional, rather than copied or invented
Accurately representing real events, experiences, or conditions

ex.en: This small restaurant serves authentic dishes from the region.
ex.zh: 这家小餐馆供应这个地区的正宗菜肴。

ex.en: Museums should preserve authentic objects while using digital tools to make local history more accessible.
ex.zh: 博物馆应保存真品，同时利用数字工具让公众更容易了解当地历史。

tip: authentic强调真品或正宗，不只表示事实正确。

senses.en: to openly claim a feeling or belief, sometimes without sincerity
to declare that you follow a particular religion

ex.en: My cousins profess to love cooking but always order takeaway.
ex.zh: 我的表亲们声称喜欢做饭，却总是点外卖。

ex.en: Many companies profess a commitment to sustainability, yet their production methods continue to generate substantial waste.
ex.zh: 许多企业宣称致力于可持续发展，但其生产方式仍不断产生大量废物。

col: profess a belief｜公开表达信念
tip: 正式用语；profess to do常暗示声称未必属实。

senses.en: A set of clothes worn together for a particular occasion.
To provide someone or something with necessary equipment or clothes.
A group or organization working together, used informally.

ex.en: She chose a bright outfit for her birthday party.
ex.zh: 她为自己的生日聚会挑了一套鲜艳的衣服。

ex.en: Schools should outfit science laboratories with modern equipment so that students can develop practical research skills.
ex.zh: 学校应为科学实验室配备现代设备，让学生能够培养实际研究技能。

col: matching outfit｜搭配协调的全套服装
outfit something with equipment｜为某物配备设备
tip: 一套衣服可说an outfit；动词常接with。

senses.zh: 挫折， 倒退， 失败

senses.en: preparing or changing materials through a series of operations
using a computer to organise, change, or analyse information

ex.en: These apples are ready for processing into juice.
ex.zh: 这些苹果已准备好加工成果汁。

ex.en: Modern food processing can extend shelf life, although some methods reduce the nutritional value of fresh ingredients.
ex.zh: 现代食品加工可以延长保质期，不过某些方法会降低新鲜食材的营养价值。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；processing plant指加工厂。

senses.en: Not drunk or affected by alcohol.
Serious and sensible, or plain rather than bright.
To become or make someone less drunk or more serious.

ex.en: My uncle stayed sober and drove everyone home safely.
ex.zh: 我叔叔没有喝醉，开车把大家安全送回了家。

ex.en: A sober assessment of environmental risks is essential before governments approve major construction projects.
ex.zh: 政府批准大型建设项目之前，必须冷静评估环境风险。

tip: sober up表示醒酒；sober也可形容冷静的判断。

senses.zh: 结晶； 变得清晰而明确； 使具体化

senses.en: Attractive in a sweet or charming way.

ex.en: That cute kitten is sleeping inside my slipper.
ex.zh: 那只可爱的小猫正睡在我的拖鞋里。

ex.en: Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.
ex.zh: 广告常用可爱的动物吸引注意，让人们对产品产生好感。

tip: 偏口语，常形容婴儿、小动物或讨喜的外表。

senses.zh: 名义上的， 有名无实的； 很少的， 象征性的； 名词性的
星系； 银河系， 银河； 一群

senses.en: Very tired, especially after prolonged effort
No longer interested in something because it continues too long
To make someone tired or become tired of something

ex.en: The weary hikers rested beside a stream before sunset.
ex.zh: 日落前，疲惫的徒步者们在溪边休息。

ex.en: Commuters who endure long journeys often arrive home too weary to exercise or spend quality time with family.
ex.zh: 通勤路途漫长的人到家后往往疲惫不堪，无力锻炼或好好陪伴家人。

tip: weary是疲倦的；wary是警惕的，注意拼写。

senses.zh: 淹没， 浸没； 难倒， 压倒

senses.en: Land almost surrounded by water but connected to a larger landmass.

ex.en: We cycled around the peninsula and stopped at a beach.
ex.zh: 我们骑车绕着半岛游览，在一处海滩停了下来。

ex.en: Tourism on the peninsula provides local employment, but excessive development could damage its fragile coastal habitats.
ex.zh: 半岛上的旅游业为当地提供了就业机会，但过度开发可能破坏其脆弱的沿海栖息地。

col: the tip of the peninsula｜半岛的尖端
tip: 半岛与大陆相连；island指四面环水的岛。

senses.zh: 居住的， 住宅的； 寄宿的， 住在住所的

senses.en: push a sharp object into something or someone

senses.zh: 突发的刺痛或强烈情绪
senses.en: a sudden sharp pain or strong feeling
an attempt to do something

ex.en: She stabbed a potato with her fork to test it.
ex.zh: 她用叉子戳了戳土豆，看看熟了没有。

ex.en: Many graduates feel a stab of anxiety when considering their employment prospects in an uncertain economy.
ex.zh: 在经济形势不明朗时，许多毕业生想到自己的就业前景便会突然感到焦虑。

col: a stab of pain｜一阵刺痛
tip: have a stab at doing表示尝试做某事，较口语化。

senses.en: Working together with others to achieve a shared goal
Helping an enemy that controls your country

ex.en: Our garden makeover was a collaboration between several neighbours.
ex.zh: 我们花园的改造是几位邻居合作完成的。

ex.en: Closer collaboration between universities and local businesses can help students develop practical skills before entering the workforce.
ex.zh: 大学与当地企业更紧密的合作可以帮助学生在就业前培养实用技能。

tip: 普通语境指合作；通敌义须结合战争背景。

senses.en: to break, or make something break, into small pieces
to gradually lose strength, effectiveness, or power

ex.en: The dry biscuit crumbled as I picked it up.
ex.zh: 我拿起那块干饼干时，它碎了。

ex.en: Without regular maintenance, historic buildings may crumble, causing communities to lose an important part of their heritage.
ex.zh: 如果没有定期维护，历史建筑可能逐渐坍塌，使社区失去重要的文化遗产。

col: crumble under pressure｜在压力下崩溃
tip: 既可指实物碎裂，也可指信心、权力等崩溃。

senses.zh: 拯救， 解救； 解救措施
表演场地， 竞技场； 活动场所

senses.en: Appear as a large, often threatening or unclear shape.
Seem likely to happen soon, causing worry.
A machine or frame used to weave cloth.

ex.en: A huge ship loomed out of the morning fog.
ex.zh: 一艘巨轮从晨雾中隐约显现。

ex.en: As water shortages loom, governments must invest in efficient irrigation and encourage households to reduce unnecessary consumption.
ex.zh: 随着缺水危机逼近，政府必须投资高效灌溉，并鼓励家庭减少不必要的用水。

col: loom large｜显得突出而令人担忧
tip: 动词常带压迫或担忧感；loom large指问题突出。

senses.en: Not moving or changing position.

ex.en: Our bus remained stationary while passengers climbed aboard.
ex.zh: 乘客上车时，我们的公交车一直停着没动。

ex.en: Stationary vehicles with running engines contribute to urban air pollution without providing any transport benefit.
ex.zh: 停着却未熄火的车辆加剧了城市空气污染，却没有发挥任何运输作用。

tip: stationary指静止的；stationery指文具，读音相同。

senses.en: To turn something upside down or reverse its order.

ex.en: Invert the bowl carefully to release the jelly.
ex.zh: 小心地把碗倒扣过来，让果冻脱模。

ex.en: Researchers can invert the usual teaching sequence by asking students to explore problems before receiving formal explanations.
ex.zh: 研究人员可以颠倒通常的教学顺序，让学生先探究问题，再接受正式讲解。

tip: 通常是及物动词；倒置的用inverted。

senses.en: Separate and distinct rather than joined or continuous.

ex.en: We divided the project into three discrete tasks.
ex.zh: 我们把这个项目分成了三项独立的任务。

ex.en: Researchers classified participants into discrete groups to compare the effects of different teaching methods.
ex.zh: 研究人员将参与者分成不同的组，以比较不同教学方法的效果。

tip: 勿混 discreet（谨慎的）；两词读音相同。

senses.zh: 精神科医生， 精神病专家

senses.en: Prevent an activity or system from continuing normally.

ex.en: Heavy snow could disrupt our train journey tomorrow.
ex.zh: 大雪可能会影响我们明天的火车行程。

ex.en: Frequent power cuts disrupt online learning, particularly in rural communities where reliable internet access is already limited.
ex.zh: 频繁停电扰乱了在线学习，在本就缺乏可靠网络的农村社区尤其如此。

tip: 及物动词，直接接活动或系统；不是形容词。
